peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (97.6): 7.1 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 383 of 393 similar developments with a figure (the same as 1). Context, not scored: resales in 29.2% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments

missing.reason: too few comparable resales for a price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few comparable resales for a price comparison.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Farrer Park MRT about 30 m, Little India MRT about 530 m; closer than 661 of 662 similar developments (the same as 1). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 6 within 2 km; nearest Farrer Park Primary School about 310 m; more than 126 of 662 similar developments (the same as 165). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 10 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 310 m), more than 426 of 662 similar developments (the same as 86); nearest hawker centre Berseh Food Centre about 590 m; nearest park Mount Emily Park about 880 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Piccadilly Grand, 1 new sales, about 120 m; Duet @ Emily, 3 new sales, about 870 m; The Collective at One Sophia, 16 new sales, about 1,180 m; Orchard Sophia, 13 new sales, about 1,190 m; Sanctuary@Newton, 16 new sales, about 1,410 m; Midtown Modern, 1 new sales, about 1,470 m; Aurea, 39 new sales, about 1,660 m; Midtown Bay, 4 new sales, about 1,710 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 335 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 128 new sales and 987 resales (1,115 purchases); new sales were 11.5% of these purchases. Subsales (51) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 987 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 549 of 662 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 987 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 1,020 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−3.2%). Planning-area private resales −9.4%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
